data.subject: Your FCL Quote: Rotterdam to New York, 1 x 40HC (machinery parts)
data.body:
Dear Sophie Meijer,

Thank you for your quote request. Please find our offer below.

Shipment details:
- Lane: Rotterdam -> New York
- Container: 1 x 40HC
- Commodity: machinery parts

All-in total: EUR 3520

This all-in rate includes base ocean freight, BAF, terminal handling at Rotterdam and New York, ISPS, documentation and export customs clearance.

Validity: this quote is valid through 2026-12-31.

If you would like to proceed, please reply to confirm and send us your cargo-ready date and shipper/consignee details. We will then arrange the booking. If you have any questions, we are happy to help.

Kind regards,

Linkport Forwarders BV
